ephemeral.description: Required exact Sandbox A startup contract. Use the YAML strings "true" or "false"; YAML booleans and all other shapes are invalid.

confidenceThreshold.description: T-517: Presidio (L2) confidence floor, rendered into the sanitizer ConfigMap as `presidio.confidence_threshold` (templates/sanitizer-configmap.yaml). Bounded to a finite [0, 1] because a value the sanitizer cannot use is INVISIBLE at runtime: detector scores never exceed 1.0, so `2.0` keeps ZERO detections, and a YAML `.nan` makes every confidence comparison false, which also keeps zero — in both cases the request still returns 200 and the certificate still lists `presidio_ner` in layers_active. That is a false attestation, not a degraded scan, so it is rejected at `helm template`/`helm lint` time instead of reaching the pod. NaN is caught by these bounds (every comparison against NaN is false, so it satisfies neither minimum nor maximum); a string or boolean is caught by the type. 0 and 1 are legitimate operating points and remain accepted. The sanitizer enforces the same bounds independently at boot (services/sanitizer/config.py, PresidioConfig.__post_init__) so Compose and hosted installs are covered too — this schema is the render-time half. NOTE: `helm --set` cannot express a float (strvals parses integers as int64 and leaves everything else a string), so an override must come from a values file or `--set-json sandbox-a.sanitizer.confidenceThreshold=0.35`; a plain `--set …=0.35` is now refused as a string instead of silently reaching the pod.

transport.description: T-64: closed vocabulary matching the DSA sanitizer's declared-transport contract (services/sanitizer/config.py on the feat/gliner-remote-fallback branch). Empty string (the default) means 'derive from sanitizer.piiMlClient.endpoint': deployment.yaml auto-declares in_box_plaintext when endpoint resolves to the stock in-cluster default, and emits NO LUCAIRN_PII_ML_TRANSPORT env var at all when endpoint is overridden to a non-stock address (it will not guess from address shape — an undeclared hop matches every prior kit release, so no existing install's render can break). The one render-time rejection is the inverse contradiction: transport="tailnet" together with a stock in-cluster endpoint. A typo here (e.g. "tailnett") is caught at `helm template`/`lint` time instead of silently reaching the sanitizer as an unrecognized value.
